families.entry: a match blocks a new mute for the gap and does not release a mute already open
families.entry_cold: the entry timer refreshes only while the 10-second mean is below 0.163
families.release: a match closes a mute already open and keeps it closed until that same gap ends
families.mixed: published hold: blocks the open and releases the cover. Baselines only.

gate.rule: An entry candidate passes when each tape stays within 0.5 percentage points of its own unprotected causal coverage and genuine programming muted falls on each tape. Release and mixed candidates are reported and cannot win this gate.
